summary: Builds the season-output HTML/list UI. Cleans up UI state via StateCleanupNotification, creates a path-separator menu item labeled from word_5BEB48, retrieves the entry count from the module callback table dword_7C73E0 via VehicleFieldAccessor, then loops over the list creating one menu item per entry via IndexedListEntryAccessor + UIMenuItemCreator. Returns the result of the last menu-item creation.

local_names.result: return value; cached menu-item creation result
local_names.v3: entry count retrieved from the module callback table
local_names.i: loop counter over the indexed list
local_names.v5: list entry label string for the current index

operations.description: Clean up UI state via StateCleanupNotification(this).
Create the path-separator menu item via UIMenuItemCreator(this, &word_5BEB48, 0, 0, 0, 0).
Retrieve the entry count via VehicleFieldAccessor(dword_7C73E0) and cache it in v3.
For each index i from 0 to count-1: fetch the entry label via IndexedListEntryAccessor(dword_7C73E0, i) into v5 and create a menu item via UIMenuItemCreator(this, v5, 0, 0, 0, 0), storing the result.
Return the result of the last UIMenuItemCreator call.

unresolved: The role of dword_7C73E0 as a module callback table and of word_5BEB48 as a path separator are DERIVED from the legacy analysis; not independently confirmed.
The object type behind this and the layout of the created menu items are unknown (owner UNKNOWN).
